description: skill-router: one-line reminder on each prompt so the router runs before substantial tasks. Prints text only.

hooks.command: echo "skill-router: REQUIRED first step. If this message asks for any code change (even a one- or two-line fix), or any website, design, video, image, writing, marketing, research, data or document work, invoke the skill-router skill before doing anything else. A task looking small is not a reason to skip it. Skip only for pure questions and chit-chat."
